description: Public Service Commission of Central Provincial Council -  Amendment No. 03  to  the Minute of  the  Central Provincial Public Management Assistant's Service
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns amendments to the service minute (rules/regulations) for provincial public management assistants/officers. It deals specifically with public service administration, including the renaming of a service category and changes to official terminology within a provincial public service structure. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it involves public sector service conditions, administrative instructions, and service classifications rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments, or other specialized categories.
